script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
systemctl stop karpo-vllm-development-03.service || true
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-03/ s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-single-20261120/development-03/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-single-development-05.tar.gz /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-05.tar.gz --region us-east-1 --no-progress
printf '%s  %s\n' '10634ef92d43471cf81c189e7882892a9aa8b5e10eebb95e2a65a22308b006b2' /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-05.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/karpo-vllm-development-05.tar.gz -C /opt/karpo
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps /opt/karpo/serving/vllm_karpo
mkdir -p /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-04
systemd-run --unit=karpo-vllm-development-04 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=1800 --property=StandardOutput=append:/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-04/server.log --property=StandardError=inherit --setenv=OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 --setenv=TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false --setenv=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 /opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_karpo_server.py --checkpoint /opt/karpo/models/karpo-4b --output /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-single-20261120/results/development-04 --max-seqs 1
